root.label: Lindsay Clancy first trial ends in mistrial

events.label: Lindsay Clancy first trial ends in mistrial

slots.name: trial status
slots.sentence: During Clancy's first trial, which ended Sept. 4 with a deadlocked jury, her defense argued that she was not criminally responsible because of a mental disease, specifically a rare condition called postpartum psychosis.

slots.name: jury split
slots.sentence: Sullivan had declared a mistrial with the jury split 11 to 1 in favor of acquitting Clancy of murder charges.

slots.name: children killed
slots.sentence: The 36-year-old mom's fate is in limbo after a Massachusetts jury failed to return a unanimous verdict over the 2023 strangulation deaths of her kids, Cora, 5; Dawson, 3; and Callan, 8 months.

slots.name: hearing date
slots.sentence: At a Sept. 29 status hearing – the first since the mistrial – Judge William Sullivan heard arguments on two defense motions, including one for the court to find Clancy not guilty and another on unsealing some sidebar records and jury notes.

slots.name: retrial decision status
slots.sentence: Plymouth County District Attorney Tim Cruz told reporters outside the courthouse on Sept. 29 that his office is "still working on" a decision about whether to retry her.
